Protection key count and arch key flag values and arch clear payload on each architecture.
Fault disposition values and the control flow that invokes fault huge fault map pages and writable transition hooks.

findings.text: Legacy area attributes exist for raw frame mapping and mixed mapping, possible guard, userfault write protection and missing handling with overlay permission, locked state, device IO, sequential and random read hints, fork copy suppression, expansion suppression, lock on fault, charge accounting, reserve suppression, hugetlb identity, synchronous behavior, arch private use, fork wipe, dump suppression, huge page preference and veto, mergeability, stack identity and soft dirty tracking. Each normally denotes its own legacy bit and collapses to no bits when its feature is unavailable, with soft dirty and missing handling showing explicit enabled versus disabled spellings.

Early stack, protection key shift and key bits, shadow stack with its start gap companion, strong ordering, upward and downward growth, SPARC ADI, ARM branch target identification, arch clear and mapped copy each have legacy flag identities. Where hardware or build support may be absent there are paired present versus absent spellings, with absent mapping to no bits or an empty newer set. Key shift derives from a high arch position and guard style growth flags interact with stack direction.

Memory tagging with its allowed marker, userfault minor and read write protection in both legacy and newer families, userfault missing and write protection in the newer family, allow any uncached with sealing, and droppable each have paired spellings for feature present versus absent. Present denotes its own bit while absent maps to no bits or an empty set, so composites built from them stay stable across configurations.

Incomplete stack setup combines random read with sequential read and early stack. Task sensitive data defaults combine read with write and a personality dependent exec or read choice plus may read may write may exec allowances, with fixed exec and non exec variants. Data exec is the default data set and also the default stack base. Full stack adds stack identity and accounting with a legacy conversion. Sealed system map tracks sealing when present and no bits otherwise. Access groups read write exec together. Special groups device IO with no expand and frame map with mixed map. Remap groups device IO with frame map and no expand and no dump. No khugepaged adds special and hugetlb.

Default initialization preserves no huge page. Locked mask groups locked with lock on fault in both flag families. Only maybe guard may be changed atomically. Arch clear is empty in the generic spelling and flag clear combines arch key flags with arch clear. Sticky flags always include maybe guard and add soft dirty when that feature exists. Merge ignore equals sticky. Fork preservation covers frame map with mixed map and userfault write protections and maybe guard.

Default fault behavior allows retry while staying killable and interruptible. First retry is allowed only when retry is permitted and the tried marker is not yet set. Tracing associates readable labels with write, make writable, allow retry, retry without wait, killable, tried, user, remote, instruction, interruptible and VMA lock markers.

Fault context carries an immutable header with target area, allocation mask, page offset, masked fault address and unmasked real address, plus a flag word, page table walk pointers for middle and upper levels, and the original entry value in small or middle size form. It provides slots for a copy on write page and a handler returned page, with error or no page outcomes excusing the latter. While holding the table lock it also exposes the leaf entry pointer, the protecting spin lock, and a preallocated table for atomic mapping.

Area operations form a callback table for lifecycle and fault services. Lifecycle covers open on split fork or remap, close on removal, mapped on first insertion with private data output, split permission check, remap, and pre change protection check without area mutation. Fault and access services cover normal fault, huge fault by order, batched mapping over an offset range, preferred page size query, transition to writable for file and frame map cases, cross process access, special name query, NUMA policy set and get, normal page lookup for special entries, and an optional userfault operations link. Documented context is user context that may sleep while holding the address space semaphore.

First mapping invokes the mapped hook unless merged with a neighbour, passing range with offset with file and private data output where success keeps the area and failure unmaps it, and this hook is valid only from prepare style setup. Later remap split or fork invokes open while removal invokes close, each under address space lock. Split and protection changes consult their dedicated hooks before proceeding.

Automatic NUMA balancing state attached to an area initializes to empty and releases with a deallocator when the feature is present, while both helpers become no operations when the feature is absent.

Fault lock release and lock assertion choose between per area read handling and address space semaphore handling based on whether the VMA lock marker is present in fault flags. Without per area locking both collapse to address space unlock or assert. Per area assert falls back to address space assert when per area support is disabled, and write assert then means address space write held.

Per area read release drops one counted reference while releasing lock tracking, using a saved address space pointer in case the area disappears. If the remaining count indicates readers are excluded and this was the last blocking reader, a writer waiter is awakened, with a small race window that can cause extra wakeups. Decrement to zero signals full release. Address space read unlock traces release when enabled then releases the read side. With per area support disabled the per area end helper is empty and trace release can also be empty.

Per area lock assertion has two modes. With dependency tracking it requires read held and otherwise requires write held. Without it a count above one means locked, zero means a detachment bug, and one requires a write held check. Write held compares the area sequence against the address space sequence while requiring address space write held. The dependency map points at per area storage when enabled and is null otherwise.

Per area references move among detached, attached unlocked, read held, write held, and reader exclusion with temporary readers, where exclusion completes only after counted readers drain and the last release wakes the waiter. Fault retry moves from first attempt to tried, where the tried marker blocks a second first style retry and later behavior depends on retry without wait.

Address space flag word supports atomic test and set, test and clear, unconditional set, unconditional clear, and clearing of the whole range through private accessors. Each operates on a numbered bit index for a given address space descriptor.

Leaf entry pointer with its lock and preallocated table are trustworthy only while the table lock is held, and the table may be absent so a null leaf must be tolerated. Handler page output discipline distinguishes normal return from no page and error cases, with error implying no page. One shot area warnings dump the area once per site when enabled and otherwise only validate the condition at build time.
